prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly TWO equal square cells side-by-side, REAR then BOTTOM, for the UP-oriented short asphalt stair module shown in the canonical source. The labeled reference contact contains the native source and accepted FRONT/TOP/RIGHT/LEFT. Source controls identity and stair direction; accepted TOP/side views fix footprint and tread run. Draw exact orthographic principal projections, no isometric or perspective.

Cell 1 REAR: show the opaque reverse support face at the far end of this same stair flight, a closed dark charcoal/asphalt-backed sloped support with the correct high/low end for the up stair orientation. It must not show the forward-visible tread pattern, and must not depict the opposite up/down state. Retain the source dark asphalt and light side curb materials.
Cell 2 BOTTOM: camera directly below looking up. Show a full-depth underside plane matching the accepted TOP footprint length and side profiles, with plausible plain dark asphalt/stone substrate and side-curb underside along the footprint. Do NOT show any upward tread surfaces, colored lane markings or front-facing stairs. Match the existing TOP XY extent, not half-depth.

Keep both projections centered, their shared world-axis orientation consistent, transparent margins, no guide marks, no labels, no shadows, no clipping, crisp clustered pixel art.
